summary: The jointly feasible symmetric bridge-tilt grid executed for fixed and rebuilt treatment labels under pooled and family-month models. Thirty-one eligible split sources account for 14.86 percent of supported early routed stock. Across K=0.25 to 4, pooled coefficients range from -0.1446 to -0.1163 and all pooled paired occupation-clustered intervals versus K=1 contain zero. Family-month coefficients range from -0.0783 to 0.0439 and are more sensitive: five of six rebuilt-treatment paired occupation-clustered intervals exclude zero, including a 0.0656 movement at K=0.25 with interval [0.0031, 0.1280]. Null intervals imply non-detection, never economic equivalence.
